text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
――――Bwahahaha!!!
――――Haaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha...!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――OOOAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! In first place is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold is so strong!
She's not falling behind T.M. Opera O at all...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
They said "The era of Opera O has arrived,"
but we still don't know for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No matter where she is,
her presence is just overwhelming—
—That was splendid.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Opera O...—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even with the Supreme Ruler's radiance still lingering over the crowd,
you really did manage to steal quite a few gazes from me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A true trickster.
――Fit to grace my stage!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
...Well, I'm honored."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall allow it, Stego-san!
To vie for supremacy against me! To rebel!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: P-Please wait up!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, SteGo-san...!
Your race today was really... really
incredible, but...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't want to give it up...!
Anything... but that...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Then let's race.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...I don't expect you to just hand it over to me, you know."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete and fight to claim it all.
The era. The path of supremacy. And the seat of the rival.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I will do so.
...What will you do, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You've got good eyes.
...They hold that undaunted color I love so much.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Inciting such strife, it is truly akin to Loge himself.
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Can you burn this Overlord to ashes, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: We can just test that out from here on.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go together!
To the second act of my grand stage!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Stay Gold's
Takarazuka Kinen came to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...I have no idea what the me
in that other world was thinking, but—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Opera O really is incredible after all.
...Seeing her reminded me once again what it truly means to be the center of an era.
choice_data_list: On this trip, it's your turn to feel that way.
On this trip, it's your turn to feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Maybe I'll stir up a little wind of rebellion.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Still... haha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Competing for the pinnacle of an era
is way more fun than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...I can still hunger for more. To be stronger, fiercer—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I wonder what will happen at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn's presence is still far off.
Yet her heart, and her eyes, gaze far into the distance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for its arrival.
...For the yet unseen "Tenno Sho (Autumn)".
